The '''Alliance Debris''' was an inoperative [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Kashyyyk resistance/Legends|freedom fighters]] were sighted in the station's vicinity.<ref name="Sony" />
